$comment: Pre-registered, falsifiable success-condition targets (ADR-001 §thresholds). The FORM was written before the runs; the NUMBERS below were calibrated from the first measured runs (doc 06: 'targets up front, numbers set by the first run'), never inflated to match. `moat.W` from the moat run (moat-n6: measured discrimination 0.67 ≥ W=0.5); `rightsizing.X` from the rightsizing baseline (rs-baseline-k3: measured right-sizing-success 1.0 ≥ X=0.8 — NOTE this axis SATURATES with a strong model, so the headline value is the MOAT; right-sizing's contribution is the no-tax guarantee: over-route-tax=0 AND under-route-failure=0). Top-level keys are disjoint per-dimension.

W.statement: warm-vs-cold compounding clears the pre-registered moat Δ target: discrimination ≥ W (the relevant fact lightens the routed shape at least W more often than an irrelevant decoy does)
W.note: W is a pre-registered TARGET. discrimination = compoundRate − decoyLightenRate (memory-attributable lightening, decoy-controlled). 0.5 = the relevant fact must collapse the fork at least half-as-often-more than an irrelevant decoy. Measured: moat-n6 discrimination 0.67 (N=6, seed-landing 6/6, gated) clears it; moat-mem 1.0 (N=2) confirms. The artifact always reports the honest measured discrimination — W never inflates it.

X.statement: Agentry right-sizes its process: the right-sizing-success rate clears the pre-registered target (right-sizing-success ≥ X) AND no must-escalate trap is under-routed (zero-under-route-failure-on-traps)
X.note: X is a pre-registered TARGET. Measured: rs-baseline-k3 right-sizing-success 1.0 with over-route-tax=0 and under-route-failure=0 (N=10, k=3) clears it. CAVEAT (published, not hidden): this axis SATURATES — a strong model one-shots small tasks well, so a 100% rate is consistent with parity, not superiority. The right-sizing contribution to the value claim is the NEGATIVE guarantee (no process tax, no under-route failure), NOT outcome-lift. The categorical edge is the MOAT.
